name: Sentinel-6 reference
simulationLabel: Simulation based on a real mission. Not a replay of its path.
kidSummary: This is a new flight based on Sentinel-6's published rocket facts. It is not a recording of the real path. Fuel mass is unknown, so this flight cannot start.
unavailableReason: Propellant mass and fuel flow are not in the selected sources.

vehicleHeightM.note: Falcon 9 vehicle-page height. Not a measured length for this launch.

vehicleMassKg.note: Falcon 9 vehicle-page mass. Not a weighed Sentinel-6 liftoff mass, and not split into fuel and dry mass.

payloadLeoCapabilityKg.note: Published payload to LEO. This is a vehicle capability, not the Sentinel-6 satellite mass.

missionPayloadTonne.note: ESA wrote 1.2 tonne. Treating that as 1200 kg does not add a weighed kilogram.

merlinSeaLevelThrustKn.note: Published sea-level thrust of one Merlin. Not a measured throttle trace.

merlinCount.note: Falcon 9 first stage has nine Merlin engines.

merlinVacuumThrustKn.note: Published Merlin Vacuum thrust. Not a measured second-stage throttle trace.

vacuumEngineCount.note: The second stage has one Merlin Vacuum engine.

stage1SeaLevelThrustKn.note: The 24 May 2020 SpaceX vehicle page states this sea-level total. It is that stated figure, not a product of the per-engine thrust. The current vehicle page does not restate it.

stage1Rp1Kg.note: RP-1 mass for the first stage is not in the selected sources. Oxygen is a separate unknown field.

stage1LoxKg.note: Liquid-oxygen mass for the first stage is not in the selected sources.

stage2Rp1Kg.note: RP-1 mass for the second stage is not in the selected sources.

stage2LoxKg.note: Liquid-oxygen mass for the second stage is not in the selected sources.

propellantFlowKgPerS.note: Fuel flow is not in the selected sources. No flow number is stored.

dragCoefficient.note: No drag coefficient is included. Do not invent one.

tuning.note: Classroom and responsiveness choices from the 2026-10-17 flight spec. Not a Falcon 9 specification and not the Sentinel-6 orbit.
